exposure: Mode of birth (vaginal delivery, caesarean section)
cohort: The study included all women who gave birth in Umbria, Italy, between 2006 and 2017, totaling 93,403 births.
finding: The incidence of postpartum haemorrhage increased three-fold in Umbria between 2006 and 2017, with maternal morbidity, twin birth, and antepartum haemorrhage identified as significant risk factors.
mod_finding: The PPH trend increased by 53% in caesarean sections and by a more significant 233% in vaginal deliveries during the study period.
